desc: Parse input: read N, K, and array A from stdin.
Compute total XOR of all elements; if K > N/2, flip to complement problem (K = N-K, adjust target using total XOR).
Enumerate combinations over the smaller side via itertools.combinations.
For each combination, compute XOR and track maximum (if using complement, XOR with total).
Handle edge cases: K=N (answer total XOR), K=1 (max element), K=N-1 (complement enumeration).
Implement and output the complete Python solution.
